description: Pause or resume a job alert, or replace its filter. A new filter starts from now: jobs already open are not emailed. Needs the user's personal access token.

active.description: false pauses the alert's emails, true resumes them.

filter.description: The whole new filter. It replaces the old one.

salary_min.description: Lowest monthly salary in shekels, e.g. "30000".

search.description: Words to search for, as on the board, e.g. "devops".

seniority.description: Comma-separated: intern, junior, mid, senior, staff, principal, lead, manager, director, exec.

name: update_alert
title: Change a job alert
